findings: C909 is translated from (3.85,17.75) to (3.85,18.4) and rotated from -90 to 180 degrees. C911 and all fixed interfaces remain unchanged.

The old HEAD_VM via moves from (6.65,17.955) to (6.6,17.8) with 0.80/0.40 mm sizes retained; its filled In2 feed remains intact. All original ground vias remain unchanged.

The front output feed now goes directly from the L901-side copper to C904.1, then vertically to the original (11.5,22.8) via with 0.50 mm copper.

New C909 and via paths to C911, C904, L901 and all three original local RAW vias pass 0.48 mm erosion. The inherited 0.30 mm U1201 input branch passes 0.28 mm and remains below a 0.48 mm corridor in both source and candidate.
All fifty power-width, 155 GND, 63 adjacency and old/new trace-reference regressions pass. Six historical transition flags remain.
